clauses.requirement: Lamps approved for and equipped with LED substitute light source(s) may be used only where the statement in paragraph 3.2.8 is present and positive; at type approval and in conformity of production verification, the presence of the marking on the lamps related to the use of LED substitute light source(s) shall be checked.
If the vehicle has a Driver Assistance Projection, it shall be constituted of patterns, symbols or both.

If the vehicle has a Driver Assistance Projection, its symbols and patterns shall be related and limited only to warning/highlighting: (a) the presence of a hazardous traffic situation; (b) the presence of other road users which require the driver's attention; (c) maintaining distances to surrounding road users and infrastructure; (d) maintaining the correct lane; the patterns and symbols shall be explained in the owner's handbook.

If front fog lamps are fitted, it shall be possible to switch them ON and OFF independently of the main-beam headlamps, dipped-beam headlamps or any combination of them, unless: (a) the front fog lamps are used as part of another lighting function in an AFS, in which case switching ON the front fog lamps function shall have priority over the function of which they are a part; or (b) the front fog lamps cannot be simultaneously lit with any other lamps with which they are reciprocally incorporated, as indicated by the symbol "/" according to paragraph 10.1 of Annex 1 of UN Regulation No. 19 or item 9.5.1 of Annex 1 of UN Regulation No. [RID].
If front fog lamps are fitted, a closed-circuit tell-tale for them is mandatory.

If front fog lamps are fitted and the communication form of UN Regulation No. 19 or 149 (Annex 1) gives a positive indication under "Luminous intensity is variable", the alignment and luminous intensities of the front fog beam may be automatically adapted to the prevailing ambient conditions; any variation of luminous intensity or alignment shall be performed automatically and in such a way that no discomfort is caused to the driver or other road users.
The reversing lamp shall comply with the individual specifications of UN R48 paragraph 6.4 (heading for the reversing lamp requirements).
The reversing lamp is mandatory on motor vehicles (including M1 passenger cars) and on trailers of categories O2, O3 and O4, and optional on trailers of category O1.
